name: strength-meter
title: StrengthMeter
description: Four bars that fill and change colour with strength, e.g. for passwords.

accessibility: role="meter" with aria-valuetext ("Strong"), not just a number.
The level is written out in text, so colour is never the only signal.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) fills without animating.
